items.label: Enhance Your Patio
items.value: The SERWALL 7-piece combination sofa set consists of a 3-seater sofa, 2 single-seat chairs, 1 coffee table, and 1 double-layer side table. With the SERWALL patio conversation set, you can create a stylish and comfortable seating area in your patio, providing a perfect spot for relaxation and entertainment.

items.label: Exceptional Durability & All Weather
items.value: Crafted with HDPE material, this outdoor sectional sofa is built to last, withstanding the test of time and heavy use, each seat can hold up to 360LBS. The weather-resistant HDPE material ensures that this sofa can withstand various weather conditions, making it perfect for outdoor use.

items.label: Generous Size
items.value: Unlike traditional rattan sofas, our outdoor modular sofa offers larger dimensions (Measured 31.5''L x 32.1''W x 30.3''H), providing ample space for you and your loved ones to relax and unwind. The extra size ensures enhanced comfort, allowing you to fully stretch out and enjoy the outdoors in utmost relaxation.

items.label: Enhanced Comfort
items.value: Our patio sofa set features premium, 3.5-inch thick high-density foam cushions, providing unparalleled comfort and support during those long hours of relaxation or socializing. With an extra thick 7-inch pillow for the backrest, you can rest assured that your seating experience will be nothing short of luxurious.

items.label: 1000 Days Trial
items.value: Your satisfaction is our top priority. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and support. Each of our 7-piece patio sofa sets comes with SERWALL's assurance of quality and customer satisfaction. If you have any questions or concerns, our dedicated customer service team is ready to assist you.
